rationale: Box half-width without the coverage factor k_g: the box is the 1-sigma box (68 % per parameter), not the 99 % joint-coverage box, so the bound-worst search covers far too little.
Off-by-one in the corner enumeration: the all-upper-bound corner is never evaluated, so a worst case at that vertex can be missed.

pattern: a = alpha;            % one-sided: the whole alpha in the lower tail
rationale: The one-sided lower bound computed with the two-sided alpha/2: the bound is too conservative (97.5 % instead of 95 %) and the ROBUST threshold moves.
Monte Carlo success sign flipped: a WORSE Level (a larger number) counts as holding the nominal Level.
Confirmation result ignored: the fresh assessment at the arg-min finds a smaller margin at another condition (a moving limit), but the search value over the candidates is reported.
